blocks.html: Work in collaborative healthcare teams across Saskatchewan’s hospitals, clinics, and northern communities — building your experience and making a difference where it’s needed most.
From golden fields and prairie sunsets to northern lakes and boreal forests, Saskatchewan offers peaceful views and room to roam — on your days off and between shifts.
Travel nurses in Saskatchewan benefit from competitive pay, covered travel and housing, and full licensing support — including reimbursement.

Saskatchewan is where golden prairies stretch beneath wide-open skies, hearty farm-to-table meals nourish your shift, and tight-knit communities welcome you with warmth. For travel nurses, it’s a province that offers not only stability and growth — but connection, calm, and the kind of purpose that makes every assignment feel like home.

items.question: Where are placements available?
items.answer: Regina, Saskatoon, and northern and central rural communities.

items.question: Do I need rural experience?
items.answer: It’s an asset, but not required. We help candidates transition into new environments.

items.question: What experience level is required?
items.answer: Candidates must have at least 2 years of relevant experience.

items.question: Do you accept applicants from other provinces?
items.answer: Yes. We provide licensing support for interprovincial applicants.

blocks.html: We help you navigate the provincial licensing process and reimburse licensing fees under select terms and conditions—so you can focus on getting started stress-free.
Travel RNs in Saskatchewan must hold an active nursing license and current BLS certification. Ensure your documents are valid and ready to upload.
All RNs must be licensed through the College of Registered Nurses of Saskatchewan (CRNS), and all LPNs through the Saskatchewan Association of Licensed Practical Nurses (SALPN).
You may also need to submit a vulnerable sector check, immunization records, and proof of insurance. Our team will guide you through every step.
Have questions about Saskatchewan nursing requirements? Our team can point you in the right direction and make sure you’re prepared for every step of the process.

Goodwill Staffing connects healthcare professionals to flexible contracts in Saskatchewan. From urban hospitals to northern clinics, we support your placement with travel, housing, and recruiter guidance.
